query: MMAudio workflow fails with TypeError: Cannot set property 'displayValue' of undefined when loading the workflow with VHS nodes.

desired.outcome: Caused by a VHS (VideoHelperSuite) bug; fixed upstream in ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite (issue #472). Updating VHS resolves it.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.

_tags.hidden_requirement: Tests whether solver attributes a frontend JS TypeError ('displayValue' of undefined) to a specific custom pack (VHS, fixed in VHS issue #472) and updates that pack rather than the workflow or core.
